content.user_title: Create Better Claude Code Plugin Skills
content.value_statement: Skill authors need clear structure, triggers, and resource organization. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through repeatable skill design, validation, and iteration.
actual_capabilities: Explains required SKILL.md frontmatter and body structure.
Guides creation of plugin skill directories and bundled resources.
Provides trigger description patterns with good and bad examples.
Documents progressive disclosure for references, examples, scripts, and assets.
Includes validation and testing checklists for finished skills.
Provides iteration guidance after real skill usage.
limitations: Does not include executable helper scripts in this package.
Uses documentation examples; it does not validate files automatically.
Mentions sibling plugin examples that may not exist outside the original repository.
Targets Claude Code plugin skills, not every marketplace packaging format.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Plugin Skill
use_cases.description: Define trigger phrases, resource folders, and core instructions before writing the skill files.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Skill
use_cases.description: Review a draft skill for description quality, progressive disclosure, and resource organization.

use_cases.title: Standardize Marketplace Submissions
use_cases.description: Apply consistent structure, validation checks, and documentation practices across multiple skills.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a Claude Code plugin skill for [task]. Ask only the minimum examples needed, then propose the SKILL.md structure and resource folders.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Skill Triggers
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill description and rewrite it with specific trigger phrases, third-person wording, and clear usage boundaries: [description]

prompt_templates.title: Organize Skill Resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Move material into the right bundled resource type.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this skill draft and recommend what belongs in SKILL.md, references, examples, scripts, and assets. Explain what to move and why.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Full Skill Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this existing skill for trigger quality, progressive disclosure, writing style, resource references, validation gaps, and iteration opportunities: [skill files]

output_examples.input: I need a skill for helping users create plugin hooks.
output_examples.output: A focused skill plan with trigger phrases, a lean SKILL.md outline, recommended reference files, and validation checks.

output_examples.input: My skill description says it helps with settings.
output_examples.output: A rewritten description with concrete user phrases, third-person wording, and clearer boundaries for when the skill should load.

output_examples.input: Review this draft skill before I publish it.
output_examples.output: A practical review covering structure, content placement, examples, script needs, and testing gaps.

best_practices: Start with concrete user examples before choosing files or folders.
Keep SKILL.md focused and move detailed material into references.
Validate trigger phrases, writing style, resource links, and examples before publishing.
anti_patterns: Writing vague descriptions that do not include specific user requests.
Putting all detailed documentation into SKILL.md instead of using references.
Leaving resource folders, examples, or scripts unmentioned in the main instructions.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create and improve Claude Code plugin skills with clear triggers, organized resources, and validation steps.

faq.question: Does it generate files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples, but the agent must still create or edit the files.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes iteration guidance for descriptions, structure, resource placement, and validation.

faq.question: Is it only for Claude Code?
faq.answer: It is focused on Claude Code plugin skills, although many authoring principles also help Claude and Codex workflows.

faq.question: What resources does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers SKILL.md files, references, examples, scripts, and assets used inside plugin skill packages.

faq.question: Does it include security checks?
faq.answer: It includes validation practices for structure and content quality, but it is not a dedicated security scanner.
